name: gqrac3-area-claim-warnings
goal: The area-claim launch gate holds a launch only when two sessions declared the same code area; a missing GitHub read binding, unknown or inferred areas, over 512 mentioned paths, open pull requests, undeclared runs and an unreachable hub become warnings in the session brief

evidence: r1304 reproduction at c6fc9eb4e7: with the live launcher routing (no github binding: 0/6 primary, 0/4 MB2) #462 holds every GitHub-checkout launch; items naming no path claim '.' and block each other; >512 mentioned paths throws and holds; open PRs hold. Expected (Daniel via CoS 17:05Z, Option 1): hold only when two sessions declared the same code area (Areas: lines or tracker claim); otherwise start and warn in the brief.

#462's tests asserted the strict behaviour (inventory rejects without a GitHub binding; unknown text claims every open PR) and its dispatch test only used declared areas on a non-Git root with a hub link, so no fixture routed a GitHub checkout without a binding or two items with no declared areas; 4 older tracker-host-resources/quota-pause tests do the latter and were not run before. New reusable fixture test/support/trackerAreaFixture.ts routes a GitHub origin with no binding by default.
